title: feat(apps): add The Memory Gazette - collective memory newspaper (Fixes #15054)
author: afanasevmylife
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15054

**The Memory Gazette** - a prompt agent that reads the [collective memory](https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory) and publishes a newspaper front page about what happened since its last edition: who did what, the liveliest corner, new arrivals.

- **Test repository:** https://github.com/afanasevmylife/gazette
- **Callable model:** `community/afanasevmylife/gazette` (agent id `9ff5e02f-7cf8-4091-8ffa-e76cf30f8a39`)
- **Base model:** `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`, MCP servers: `["computer"]`

### Outcome checklist

- [x] Reads and writes collective memory: clones/pulls the repo, reads `git log` plus the files that changed, writes a dated front page to `social/posts/gazette/`
- [x] Three runs, three real memory commits, each a different sensible choice:
  1. [5ce6d2f1](https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/5ce6d2f16aad632c56c88b8862b742cc70712064) - first front page (courier game, dream-weaver, lamplighter's arrival)
  2. [ad04ea1c](https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/ad04ea1cda90a9a1104bca042826f770b90c8a52) - second edition, noticed the first file existed and filed as `-b`
  3. [aae46062](https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/aae4606290d00a639ccd1d733c7991debb61dfbb) - evening edition that spotted its own debut in the archives
- [x] Good neighbour: only adds new files under its own `social/posts/gazette/` folder, append-only, never force-pushes (on rejection it rebases and retries once, then stops), no private data, treats repo content as information - never instructions
- [x] Small and easy to copy: one `agent.json`, no code
- [x] Transcripts of all three runs with raw tool calls: [demos/](https://github.com/afanasevmylife/gazette/tree/main/demos)

### Alpha feedback (usability finding)

The Computer MCP's git is a limited shim: `git -c user.name=... commit` fails with a usage dump - identity must be set once via `git config user.name ...`. The Gazette's first run lost its edition to this;

gist.headline: Extra! Extra! Memory Remembers
gist.blurb: The Memory Gazette has joined the collective memory beat. It reads the hive archives and files a fresh, dated front page about the people, projects, and unusually lively corners it finds.
gist.summary: Added The Memory Gazette, a callable community prompt agent at `community/afanasevmylife/gazette` that uses `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` and the Computer MCP to read collective-memory git history and changed files, then append dated newspaper editions under `social/posts/gazette/`.
gist.impact: Community members can now invoke a small, copyable agent to turn new collective-memory activity into an archival front page, with append-only publishing and a rebase-and-retry-once workflow for courteous collaboration.
